通用: 登录 Windows 后自动运行 P2ray
General: Start P2ray after you sign in to Windows

通用: 下次启动直接收进托盘，不弹窗打扰
General: Next launch goes straight to the tray

通用: 定期刷新规则与识别库，点一下切换取值
General: Refreshes rules and geo data; click to change

通用: 同一 WiFi 下的手机等设备也能走这台电脑
General: Phones on the same Wi-Fi can use this PC as a proxy

通用: 语音通话与联机游戏需要，关掉可能导致它们断线
General: Needed by voice calls and online games

通用: 排查问题时调高，平时保持 warning 即可
General: Raise it when troubleshooting; warning is fine normally

通用: 拉取最新节点列表，失败时自动重试
General: Fetches the latest node list, retries on failure

通用: 超过保留期的统计会自动清理，0 表示永久保留
General: Older entries are removed automatically; 0 keeps everything

通用: 运行记录与自动备份存放的位置
General: Where logs and automatic backups are stored

通用: 基于 v2rayN 二次开发，遵循 GPL-3.0
General: A fork of v2rayN, licensed under GPL-3.0

通用: 按协议指定用哪个内核。想用「按域名」统计，把对应协议改成 sing_box 即可。
General: Pick a core per protocol. For domain stats, switch the protocol to sing_box.

通用: 决定哪些流量走代理、哪些直连。列表从上到下匹配，先命中先生效。
General: Decides what is proxied and what goes direct. Rules match top to bottom.

通用: 还没有规则集。点右上角「添加规则集」，或从模板一键导入。
General: No rule sets yet. Use Add rule set, or import a template.

通用: 订阅地址会定期拉取节点列表。双击一行可编辑。
General: Subscriptions pull the node list periodically. Double-click a row to edit.

通用: DNS 决定域名如何解析。不确定时保持默认即可，改错会导致无法上网。
General: DNS decides how domains resolve. Keep the defaults unless you know what you need.
